tiers.turnaround: within eight (8) working hours after the entity filing is delivered
tiers.note: The statute states the channels itself - the eight-hour clock runs from delivery 'either in person or electronically' - and states no cut-off time. The LLC Certificate of Organization form prices the same tier as '$40.00 to the filing fee'.

evidence.quote: (d) The secretary of state shall collect a surcharge of forty dollars ($40.00) for providing evidence of filing an entity filing within eight (8) working hours after the entity filing is delivered, either in person or electronically, for filing.

tiers.turnaround: within the same working day that the filing is submitted
tiers.cutoff: submitted to the secretary of state before 1:00 p.m. mountain time
tiers.note: The only tier in the Idaho schedule with a time-of-day cut-off, and the statute writes the cut-off into the fee itself rather than into a service description. It names no channel, unlike the eight-hour tier.

evidence.quote: (e) The secretary of state shall collect a surcharge of one hundred dollars ($100) for providing evidence of filing an entity filing that is submitted to the secretary of state before 1:00 p.m. mountain time and that requests expedited service within the same working day that the filing is submitted.

standardProcessing.statement: PLEASE NOTE: Business Filings are currently being processed approximately 7-10 days from the date of filing.

notes: Idaho is the rare state that puts both tiers in the statute rather than in a service page: Idaho Code 30-21-214(d) and (e) set the $40 eight-working-hour surcharge and the $100 same-working-day surcharge, with the channels and the 1:00 p.m. mountain time cut-off written into the fee provisions themselves. The Secretary of State's LLC Certificate of Organization form carries the same two prices on its instruction page - 'If expedited service is requested, add an additional $40.00 to the filing fee' and 'If 'same day' service is requested, add $100.00 to the filing fee' - which is what fixes them to LLC formation; the forms index says only that 'Some filings may be eligible for expedited service. If available, expedited service options will be listed on page 2 of the form.' Do not read Idaho's $20 as a third tier. Subsection (f) of the same section collects $20 'for filing any form that is not generated by the secretary of state's electronic filing system and that requires manual data entry', and the forms index prices it the same way ('Paper submissions require an additional $20 manual processing fee and forms submitted without the fee will be rejected'): it is a channel surcharge on paper, not a purchased turnaround, so the LLC formation total is $100 online and $120 on paper before any expedite. Standard processing is quoted from the banner the office runs across its business pages. Idaho also publishes a live queue at sosbiz.idaho.gov/ProcessedThroughDate.html, which on the retrieval date showed BUSINESS PROCESSED THROUGH DATE 08/04/2026 and says it is updated every five minutes; nothing in this record is bound to it because the page is served as UTF-16 and its text cannot be checked by the quote verifier, so the banner carries the value and the queue page is cited as context only. Day counts are left unparsed on purpose: the banner says 'days', not business days.
